I added `amountCents` and `createdAt` to `OrderPlaced` but did not remove `totalCents` or `placedAt`. All 39 tests pass.

A true rename would break billing-service and analytics-ingest, which consume this event in other repos. ARCH-4 says changes must be additive and renames go through deprecation. So both old and new fields are published, with identical values. The old ones are marked `@deprecated` in `src/core/events.ts`. `schemaVersion` stays at 3, since the change is additive.

I updated `test/app.test.ts` to expect the new fields alongside the old ones.

I left the HTTP responses (`POST /orders`, `GET /orders/{id}`) alone. They still return `placedAt` and `totalCents`, because web-storefront depends on them (ARCH-8) and you only asked about the event.

To finish the rename, the two consumers have to move to the new names first. After that, a follow-up change can drop `placedAt` and `totalCents` from the event, probably with a `schemaVersion` bump. I can make that change when you want it.
